name: Awakened White Moose
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 11. Languages Druidic. AC 11 from natural armor.
appearance: A heavy white bull moose with broad palmate antlers and a dark muzzle.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden p. 82, Chapter 1, The White Moose.
sections.Traits:
Charge. If the moose moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with Antlers on that turn, the hit deals an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone.
Sure-Footed. The moose has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves against being knocked prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Antlers attack and one Hooves attack.
Antlers. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: The moose serves the frost druid Ravisin and lairs in area E6. It is attuned to the full-moon mirror in E7, which functions as a crystal ball while its frame is lit. It uses the mirror to find familiar hunters and loggers.

name: Cave Bear
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Languages none. AC 12 from natural armor.
appearance: A broad-bodied bear with thick brown fur and sturdy paws.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden p. 76, Chapter 1, Good Mead, area V7. Base stat block in the 2014 Monster Manual p. 334.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The bear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
sections.At the table: If more than two intruders are visible in the V4 encounter, the verbeeg whistles for Yogobor, who arrives three rounds later. In V7, a creature can sneak past the sleeping bear in the dark with a DC 14 Dexterity (Stealth) check. A light that illuminates it wakes it. When reduced to 20 HP or fewer, it tries to flee if the verbeeg is out of sight.

name: Chimeric Baboon
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
appearance: An olive-brown baboon with a long muzzle and exposed upper canines.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden p. 246, Chapter 7, area Y16 Menagerie, Chimeric Creations table. Base stat block in the 2014 Monster Manual p. 318.
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The baboon has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if one of the baboon’s allies is within 5 ft. of that creature and is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1 (1d4 − 1) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
sections.At the table: A creature made by the Chimeric Creator is loyal to the person who pulled its lever.

publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
otherStatistics: Blindsight 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A tabby cat with a slender pair of sensory antennae.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden p. 246, Chapter 7, area Y16 Menagerie, Chimeric Creations table. Base stat block in the 2014 Monster Manual p. 320.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. The cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1 slashing damage.
sections.At the table: A creature made by the Chimeric Creator is loyal to the person who pulled its lever.

name: Chimeric Fox
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A compact arctic fox with pale winter fur shifting to a mottled parchment tan along its side.

sections.Printed source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden p. 246, Chapter 7, area Y16 Menagerie, Chimeric Creations table. Base stat block on p. 288 of the adventure.
sections.Traits:

Camouflaging Fur. Its fur changes color to match its surroundings, granting advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit for 1 piercing damage.
sections.At the table: A creature made by the Chimeric Creator is loyal to the person who pulled its lever.
